question: Ali Ahmad Hussain Khan was an exponent of ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__shehnai__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ali Ahmad Hussain Khan** was a renowned **shehnai player**.
 
• He passed away on **March 16, 2016,** in **Kolkata, West Bengal**.
 
• He was known for his innovative style and mastery over the Indian classical, semi-classical and folk music reportoire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b974a4cb3820202477c57838a88e1a09224bc14fa613033e581080f14f6d2de0.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shehnai:**

 
- Traditional Indian wind instrument

 - Double reed instrument

 - Often used in North Indian weddings and processions

 - Produces a loud, clear, and penetrating sound

 - Made from wood, with a metal bell at the end

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8c36d7a0c903682a308d5f26d962c38ce830325a0eba673a052f9f89b6e1b882.png] 

 
• 
 
**Flute:**

 - Woodwind instrument

 - Has a long, narrow tube with holes for fingering

 - Produces sound by blowing air across the mouthpiece

 - Used in various musical genres, including classical, jazz, and folk music

 - Comes in different sizes, such as the piccolo, alto flute, and bass flute

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/270151ce683402bba2add260230e9c169532f79ca55b35f3d184d4d6f9ba4efb.png] 

 
• 
 
**Guitar:**

 - String instrument

 - Has six strings, typically tuned EADGBE

 - Used in a wide range of musical styles, including rock, pop, blues, and classical music

 - Played by plucking or strumming the strings

 - Comes in various types, such as acoustic, electric, and classical guitar

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/192a75b930f9f512add6673bfad2940ce34b514f997c3e94a732927b21b88b5c.png] 

 
• 
 
**Been:**

 - Traditional Indian wind instrument

 - Made from bamboo with gourds at each end

 - Played by blowing air through a mouthpiece and manipulating the gourds with the hands

 - Has a unique and haunting sound

 - Often used in folk and classical music in India

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22425b8d7e45552bfb91a5a816e2ae2d13e98415cb5a101adfd7ab388d29ff3c.png]
